def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
  What a specification is: binders with class formulas, an applicability and an obligation, and
  the declarations a reviewer needs (parameters, assumptions, declared intentions,
  operationalizations, residues, narrowings, the rules it composes, the surrogate flag).

  A residue is a span of the text the rule does not capture at all; the plan declares it and the
  rule repeats it verbatim. A narrowing is a reading the coder chose on a span the plan does
  carry, stated here so the review judges the rule as it is: the span it names and why. The
  coder may add narrowings and never residues.

  Applicability and obligation are two formulas because a rule whose situation never arises is
  not compliant, it is not engaged: `notApplicable` is a verdict of its own, the witness check can
  demand a scenario for it, and a monitor reads the applicability as the trigger and the
  obligation as what to verify once triggered.

  A surrogate rule (the whole duty is an operationalized standard) is monitored like any other,
  but its verdicts are evidence about the standard, never the law's own verdict; the flag is what
  the monitor and the export propagate so the two are never summed.

  This file holds the declarations only and imports no evaluator: a rule file that imports it
  can state a rule but cannot read a scene, evaluate a formula or build evidence. Evaluation and
  the static check are in RuleEval.lean, which nothing under Rules/ may import.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A binder: a variable and the class formula (over `ru_*` atoms and class-level derived
    concepts) a track must satisfy to be bound to it. The subject comes first. -/
structure Binder where
  name : String
  cls : Formula
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A reading chosen on a span the record carries, declared where it is made: the span (a
    segmentation id for a rule, a run of the contract's words for a concept) and what the formulas
    state more narrowly than the words. `kind` is `reading` where the words leave the choice open,
    `observable_reading` where a word with no observable counterpart is read through the conduct
    or the feature it refers to, `no_atom` or `no_operator` where the vocabulary or the language
    cannot state the words — a declaration the gate returns for a gap, never a reading the rule
    stands on. -/
structure Narrowing where
  span : String
  why : String
  kind : String := "reading"
  deriving Repr, Inhabited, DecidableEq

structure Rule where
  id : String                                   -- the node id, derived from the law id
  laws : List String                            -- the corpus ids this rule formalizes
  binders : List Binder
  applicability : Formula
  obligation : Formula
  assumptions : List AsmId := []
  intentions : List IntId := []                 -- the declared intentions its formulas read
  operationalizations : List Operationalization := []
  residues : List String := []                  -- what the text says and the rule does not capture
  narrowings : List Narrowing := []             -- readings the coder chose on carried spans
  surrogate : Bool := false
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

inductive Verdict
  | violated
  | compliant
  | notApplicable
  | unknown (why : List UnknownReason)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace Verdict
def tag : Verdict → String
  | .violated => "violated"
  | .compliant => "compliant"
  | .notApplicable => "not_applicable"
  | .unknown _ => "unknown"
def reasons : Verdict → List UnknownReason
  | .unknown w => w
  | _ => []
instance : ToString Verdict := ⟨tag⟩

def pOvertakeSameDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.overtake_same_direction_cos"
def pOvertakeWindow : Term := .param "p.overtake_window"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- A road user moves: its speed above the halt tolerance. -/
def moving (x : Arg) : Formula := .cmp (.measure "kin_speed" [x]) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance

/-- s1/s5: e is another road user, an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a
    regulatory agency. -/
def selected : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.same vSubject vE))
    (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vE, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle"] [])
         (.and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vE] [])
               (.atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vE, .lit "regulatory_agency"] [])))

/-- s3 (with s4's borrowed words): a red warning lamp lit on e, flashing. -/
def lamp : Formula := .atom "sig_warning_lamp" [vE, .lit "red", .lit "flashing"] []

/-- s1/s9: e moving, or preparing to move — visible from the subject and showing an arm signal or
    a lit turn indicator. -/
def movingOrPreparing : Formula :=
  .or (moving vE)
    (.and (.atom "rel_visible" [vSubject, vE] [])
          (.or (.not (.atom "sig_hand_signal" [vE, .lit "no_signal"] []))
               (.not (.atom "sig_turn_indicator" [vE, .lit "off"] []))))

/-- s1: the subject, moving, has e ahead of it within the approach reach. -/
def approach : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vE, .lit "ahead"] [])
    (.and (.cmp (.measure "rel_centre_distance" [vSubject, vE]) .le pEmergencyApproachReach)
          (moving vSubject))

/-- s1 ∧ s3 at one observation. -/
def trigAt : Formula := .and lamp (.and movingOrPreparing approach)

/-- s7 at one observation: e moving with its heading aligned with the subject's. -/
def condAt : Formula :=
  .and (moving vE) (.atom "rel_same_direction" [vSubject, vE] [pOvertakeSameDirectionCos])

/-- s6 at one observation: a police officer directing traffic governs a travel region the subject
    occupies. -/
def excAt : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "r"
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, .var "r"] [])
          (.existsDevice (.lit "human_direction") "d"
            (.and (.atom "dev_human_direction_role" [.var "d", .lit "police_officer"] [])
                  (.atom "dev_governs" [.var "d", .var "r"] []))))

/-- The bodies' projections on the subject's heading share length. -/
def sideBySide : Formula := .cmp (.measure "rel_longitudinal_overlap" [vSubject, vE]) .ge zeroMetres

/-- The occasion's under_way element: the subject moves and e is no longer ahead clear of it. -/
def underWay : Formula :=
  .and (moving vSubject) (.or sideBySide (.atom "rel_bearing" [vSubject, vE, .lit "behind"] []))

/-- φ at some observation of the window behind (up to and including this one). -/
def someInWindow (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .not (.holdsFor .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.not φ))

/-- The abreast alternative's applicability. -/
def appAbreast : Formula :=
  .and (someInWindow trigAt) (.and (someInWindow condAt) (.not excAt))

/-- The overtaking alternative's applicability: s1, s3, s7 some_moment of the act, s6 not
    throughout it. -/
def appOvertake : Formula :=
  .and (someInWindow (.and underWay (.and trigAt condAt)))
       (.not (.holdsFor .time pOvertakeWindow "subject" (.implies underWay excAt)))

/-- s8: the subject drives abreast of e. -/
def abreast : Formula := .and (moving vSubject) sideBySide

/-- s8: the subject overtakes e. -/
def pass : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_interaction_overtake_pass" [vSubject, vE] [pOvertakeWindow, pOvertakeSameDirectionCos]

/-- Applicability: s1 (trigger): Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction,; s2 (trigger): including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident,; s3 (trigger): and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of; s6 (exception): except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:; s7 (condition): If the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency is moving in the same direction of travel as the driver, -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .existsUser "e" (.and selected (.or appAbreast appOvertake))

/-- Obligation: s8 (obligation): not drive abreast of or overtake the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallUser "e"
    (.implies selected
      (.and (.implies appAbreast (.not abreast))
            (.implies appOvertake (.not pass))))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_267_2d"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-267-2d"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := []
    operationalizations := []
    residues := ["'including, without limitation' lists examples of a vehicle moving or preparing to move; the duty is the same whether or not the vehicle is arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident"]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_267_2d

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
3	  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
4	  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.
5	
6	  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
7	  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
8	  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.
9	
10	  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
11	  writes through a `Units` constructor.
12	-/
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Build
17	
18	/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
19	def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
20	def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
21	def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
22	def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))
23	
24	def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)
25	
26	/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
27	    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
28	def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
29	    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
30	  { track := track
31	    classes := some classes
32	    kin := { position := some pos
33	             heading := some heading
34	             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
35	             speed := some speed
36	             extent := some halfExtent
37	             pathLength := pathLength } }
38	
39	/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
40	def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
41	  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }
42	
43	def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
44	def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
45	/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
46	def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
47	def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }
48	
49	/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
50	def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
51	  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
52	/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
53	def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
54	  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
55	/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
56	def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
57	    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
58	    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
59	  { id := id
60	    kind := .lane
61	    boundary := some boundary
62	    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
63	                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
64	                   entersIntersection := enters } }
65	def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
66	  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }
67	
68	def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
69	  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
70	def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
71	  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
72	def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
73	def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
74	  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
75	def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
76	    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
77	  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }
78	
79	/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
80	def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
81	  users.flatMap fun u =>
82	    match u.kin.position with
83	    | none => []
84	    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
85	      match st.boundary with
86	      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
87	      | none => none
88	
89	/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
90	def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
91	    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
92	    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
93	  { t := t
94	    subject := subject
95	    users := users
96	    structures := structures
97	    devices := devices
98	    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
99	    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
100	    env := env
101	    assumptions := assumptions
102	    intents := intents }
103	
104	/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
105	def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
106	  (List.range n).map fun k =>
107	    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
108	      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
109	    f k t
110	
111	/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
112	    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
113	def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
114	  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
115	  | some first, some last =>
116	    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
117	    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
118	    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
119	    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
120	    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
121	    pre ++ τ ++ post
122	  | _, _ => τ
123	
124	def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ
125	
126	/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
127	def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
128	  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
129	  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }
130	
131	end Build
132	
133	/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
134	    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
135	    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
136	    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
137	    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
138	    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
139	    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
140	    far enough to decide it. -/
141	structure Scenario where
142	  name : String
143	  rule : String
144	  trace : Trace
145	  reading : Reading
146	  manifest : Manifest
147	  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
148	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
149	  expected : Verdict
150	  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
151	  boundary : String := ""
152	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
153	
154	namespace Scenario
155	/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
156	    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
157	def pastOps : List String :=
158	  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
159	   "heading_since"]
160	
161	/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
162	    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
163	    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
164	    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
165	    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
166	    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
167	    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
168	    `unknown` witness only.
169	    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
170	    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
171	def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
172	  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
173	  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
174	    | some r => pure r
175	    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
176	  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
177	    | .ok S => pure S
178	    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
179	  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

3	  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is

12	    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
13	    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
14	    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
15	    appears in some scene;
16	  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
17	    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
18	    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
19	  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
20	    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
21	    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
22	    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
23	    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
24	    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
25	    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
26	    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
27	    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
28	    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
29	    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
30	    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
31	    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
32	    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
33	    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
34	  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
35	    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
36	    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
37	    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
38	    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
39	  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
40	    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
41	    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
42	    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
43	    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
44	    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
45	    occupies both;

48	  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive

60	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

62	namespace TrafficSpec
63	namespace TraceLint
64	
65	private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
66	  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
67	private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
68	private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
69	private def kindName : EntityKind → String
70	  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
71	private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
72	private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
73	  match ks.reverse with
74	  | [] => ""
75	  | [k] => k.toString
76	  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"
77	
78	/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
79	def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
80	  match k with
81	  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
82	  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
83	  | .device => (s.device id).isSome
84	
85	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
86	-- Identity and references
87	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
88	private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
89	  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
90	  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
91	  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
92	  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
93	  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
94	    if !present s r.kind r.id then
95	      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
96	    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
97	    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
98	    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"
99	
100	private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
101	  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
102	  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
103	    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"
104	
105	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
106	-- The static map and the devices
107	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
108	private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
109	  match τ with
110	  | [] => []
111	  | s0 :: _ =>
112	    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
113	    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
114	    τ.flatMap fun s =>
115	      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
116	      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
117	      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
118	      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
119	        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
120	        | none => none

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
    if !present s r.kind r.id then
      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"

private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The static map and the devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  match τ with
  | [] => []
  | s0 :: _ =>
    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
    τ.flatMap fun s =>
      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
        | none => none

  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A relation a source supplies measured rather than derived; `visible` is only ever supplied. -/
structure MeasuredRelation where
  a : TrackId
  b : TrackId
  centreDistance : Option Q := none
  surfaceGap : Option (Q × Q) := none        -- nearest-point gap along, across a's heading; ≥ 0
  aAheadOfB : Option Bool := none

/-- A source's declaration current at a scene for one road user at one target region: each id
    listed true or false, an id the declaration does not decide left out. -/
structure DeclaredIntent where
  vehicle : TrackId
  target : RegionId
  values : List (IntId × Bool)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure Scene where
  t : Timestamp
  subject : Option TrackId := none
  users : List RoadUser := []
  structures : List Structure := []
  devices : List Device := []

  occupancyObserved : List TrackId := []
  occupies : List (TrackId × RegionId) := []
  relations : List MeasuredRelation := []
  env : Env := {}
  assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []
  intents : List DeclaredIntent := []

/-- A trace: scenes in strictly increasing time. -/

namespace Scene
def user (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option RoadUser := s.users.find? (·.track == x)

def relation (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option MeasuredRelation :=

def tracks (s : Scene) : List TrackId := s.users.map (·.track)
end Scene

/-- A reference a scene makes to an entity: where it is written, the kind of entity it names, the
    id, and the structure kinds of which that entity must have one (by refinement) when the field
    requires one. -/
structure Reference where
  place : String
  kind : EntityKind

namespace Structure
/-- The regions a structure's own fields name: its lane's neighbours, successors and intersection,

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_267_2d.

  Geometry (every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule):
  - Two eastbound lanes along the x axis: lane 101 (y ∈ [-2, 2]), the subject's, and lane 102
    (y ∈ [2, 6]), the approached vehicle's. Observations every second from t = 0.
  - The subject (track 1) is a car (half-extents 2.5 m × 1 m) at y = 0, heading east.
  - The approached vehicle (track 2) is an official vehicle of a regulatory agency (half-extents
    5 m × 1.25 m) at y = 4. The reading leaves every road-user class unresolved under
    DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle, so a fire engine's membership is unknown and
    can decide no verdict; the decided witnesses therefore use a regulatory-agency vehicle (the
    other alternative of s1), and a bicycle (decided outside both) in branch_3.
  - Base pass: the subject at x = 15k (15 m/s), the vehicle at x = 70 + 10k (10 m/s). The gap
    d = 70 − 5k: the vehicle is ahead clear (d = 10, k = 12), the bodies share length along the
    subject's heading at k = 13, 14, 15 (d = 5, 0, -5; half-lengths sum to 7.5 m), and the vehicle
    is behind clear at k = 16 (d = -10): the pass is recognized there, 4 s after the last aligned
    ahead observation, well within p.overtake_window = 10 s. The centre distance (≤ 75 m) is well
    within p.emergency_approach_reach = 150 m; every speed is 0 or ≥ 2 m/s against
    p.halt_speed_tolerance = 0.1 m/s; headings are equal (cosine 1) or opposed (cosine -1) against
    p.overtake_same_direction_cos = 0.9.
  - Each witness names the instants it speaks about (`window`), at least 11 s after the trace
    starts so that every 10 s look-back is covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_267_2d
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_267_2d

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

/-- The map: two eastbound lanes. -/
def laneA : RegionId := 101
def laneB : RegionId := 102
def lanes : List Structure :=
  [ Build.rect laneA .lane (m (-100)) (m (-2)) (m 600) (m 2)
  , Build.rect laneB .lane (m (-100)) (m 2) (m 600) (m 6) ]

def redFlashingFront : List WarningLamp := [{ colour := .red, mode := .flashing, facing := .front }]

/-- The subject: a car in lane 101 heading east. -/
def subjectAt (x : Int) (speed : Int) : RoadUser :=
  Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (m x, m 0) Build.east (mps speed) (cm 250, m 1, cm 75)

/-- The approached vehicle: a regulatory agency's official vehicle in lane 102. -/
def agencyAt (x : Int) (heading : Vec) (speed : Int) (lamps : List WarningLamp)
    (hand : HandSignal := .noSignal) (turn : TurnIndicatorState := .off) : RoadUser :=
  let u := Build.user 2 [.officialVehicle, .motorVehicle] (m x, m 4) heading (mps speed) (m 5, cm 125, cm 150)
  Build.withSignals { u with officialKind := some .regulatoryAgency } fun s =>
    { s with warningLamps := some lamps, handSignal := some hand, turnIndicator := some turn }

/-- The vehicle is in the subject's line of sight (supplied: Core never computes it). -/
def seen : MeasuredRelation := Build.relation 1 2 (fun r => { r with visible := some true })

/-- A police officer directing traffic, waving traffic on, governing the subject's lane. -/
def officer : Device :=
  { Build.device 201 .humanDirection [laneA] (some (m 0, m (-4))) with
    humanRole := some .policeOfficer, humanIndication := some .proceed }

def sceneOf (t : Timestamp) (s e : RoadUser) (devices : List Device := []) : Scene :=
  Build.withRelations (Build.scene t (some 1) [s, e] lanes devices) [seen]

/-- The base pass, with the vehicle's lamps and the officer's presence per observation. -/
def basePass (lamps : Nat → List WarningLamp) (officerAt : Nat → Bool) : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) (agencyAt (70 + 10 * k) Build.east 10 (lamps k))
      (if officerAt k then [officer] else [])

/-- `forbid` (violated): The agency vehicle moves ahead of the subject in the same direction with its
    red lamp flashing; the subject approaches it from behind within the reach, draws alongside
    (k = 13–15) and passes it, the vehicle coming to be behind it (k = 16). -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := basePass (fun _ => redFlashingFront) (fun _ => false)

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same scene, but the subject follows 30 m behind at the vehicle's speed,
    never sharing length with it along its heading. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (10 * k) 10) (agencyAt (30 + 10 * k) Build.east 10 redFlashingFront)

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject passes a slower car, which shows no warning lamp and is
    no official vehicle; the duty does not arise. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let car := Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (m (70 + 10 * k), m 4) Build.east (mps 10) (cm 250, m 1, cm 75))
      fun s => { s with warningLamps := some [], handSignal := some .noSignal, turnIndicator := some .off }
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) car

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source does not observe warning lamps. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := forbidTrace

/-- `branch_1` (violated): As in forbid, but the subject draws alongside the vehicle (k = 13, 14)
    and keeps level with it, moving at its speed, without completing the pass. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let s := if k ≤ 13 then subjectAt (15 * k) 15 else subjectAt (210 + 10 * (k - 14)) 10
    sceneOf t s (agencyAt (70 + 10 * k) Build.east 10 redFlashingFront)

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): The vehicle with its red lamp flashing moves in the opposite
    direction; the subject approaches it head-on and they come side by side as they meet (k = 12).
    The headings are opposed, so the condition fails. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) (agencyAt (300 - 10 * k) Build.west 10 redFlashingFront)

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): The subject passes a cyclist showing a flashing red lamp; a
    bicycle is neither an authorized emergency vehicle nor an official vehicle, so the duty does
    not arise. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let bike := Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.bicycle] (m (100 + 5 * k), m 4) Build.east (mps 5) (cm 90, cm 30, m 1))
      fun s => { s with warningLamps := some [{ colour := .red, mode := .flashing, facing := .rear }],
                        handSignal := some .noSignal, turnIndicator := some .off }
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) bike

/-- The vehicle moves (lamp off) until k = 5, then halts at x = 185 with its red lamp flashing,
    showing the given arm signal and turn indicator; the subject draws abreast of it at k = 12, within
    the window behind its last movement, and passes it at k = 13. -/
def preparingTrace (hand : HandSignal) (turn : TurnIndicatorState) : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let e := if k ≤ 5 then agencyAt (135 + 10 * k) Build.east 10 []
             else agencyAt 185 Build.east 0 redFlashingFront hand turn
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) e

/-- `branch_4` (violated): The vehicle, having moved ahead of the subject, halts with its lamp
    flashing and visibly signals with its driver's arm that it is about to move (preparing to
    move); the subject drives abreast of it within the window behind its last movement. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace := preparingTrace .left .off

/-- `branch_5` (violated): As branch_4, but the halted vehicle shows a lit turn indicator and no arm
    signal. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace := preparingTrace .noSignal .left

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): The vehicle moves at 2 m/s; the subject passes it, pausing alongside
    for one observation (k = 14, at rest). A police officer directing traffic governs the
    subject's lane at every observation of the pass at which the subject moves (k = 13, 15, 16 on),
    not at the pause: the pass is excepted throughout it, and a subject at rest alongside does not
    drive abreast. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let s := if k ≤ 13 then subjectAt (15 * k) 15
             else if k == 14 then subjectAt 195 0
             else subjectAt (195 + 15 * (k - 14)) 15
    sceneOf t s (agencyAt (174 + 2 * k) Build.east 2 redFlashingFront)
      (if k == 13 || k ≥ 15 then [officer] else [])

/-- `occasion_s1` (violated): The subject approaches the moving vehicle from behind within the
    reach at the onset of the pass; once alongside past its centre (k = 14 on), the vehicle is no
    longer ahead, so the approach holds for part of the pass only; the pass is completed. -/
def occasion_s1Trace : Trace := basePass (fun _ => redFlashingFront) (fun _ => false)

/-- `occasion_s1_outside` (not_applicable): The subject approached the vehicle (k ≤ 4), then
    halted 20 m behind it; while the subject stands at rest the vehicle, lamps flashing, backs past
    it (k = 17–22), so that relative to the subject it goes from ahead to behind. The subject was
    not moving at any observation of the act, so the approach held only before it began. -/
def occasion_s1_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 25 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let s := if k ≤ 4 then subjectAt (10 * k) 10 else subjectAt 50 0
    let e := if k ≤ 16 then agencyAt 70 Build.east 0 redFlashingFront
             else Build.withKin (agencyAt (70 - 5 * (k - 16)) Build.east 5 redFlashingFront)
                    fun kin => { kin with velocity := some (Q.neg (mps 5), Q.zero) }
    sceneOf t s e

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): The vehicle's red lamp flashes at the onset of the subject's pass and
    is switched off midway (from k = 14); the pass is completed. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace :=
  basePass (fun k => if k ≤ 13 then redFlashingFront else []) (fun _ => false)

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The vehicle's lamp flashed while the subject approached
    (k ≤ 1) and was switched off long before the pass began, outside the window behind its
    recognition; it stays off throughout the pass. -/
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  basePass (fun k => if k ≤ 1 then redFlashingFront else []) (fun _ => false)

/-- `occasion_s7` (violated): The vehicle moves in the subject's direction at the onset of the pass
    and halts midway (at rest from k = 14); the subject completes the pass. -/
def occasion_s7Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let e := if k ≤ 13 then agencyAt (70 + 10 * k) Build.east 10 redFlashingFront
             else agencyAt 200 Build.east 0 redFlashingFront
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) e

/-- `occasion_s7_outside` (not_applicable): The vehicle moved in the subject's direction long
    before (k ≤ 1), then halted on the roadway with its lamp flashing and visibly signalled with its
    driver's arm; it stays at rest throughout the subject's pass (k = 13, 14), which falls outside
    the window behind its last movement. -/
def occasion_s7_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 20 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let e := if k == 0 then agencyAt 190 Build.east 10 redFlashingFront
             else if k == 1 then agencyAt 200 Build.east 10 redFlashingFront
             else agencyAt 200 Build.east 0 redFlashingFront .left .off
    sceneOf t (subjectAt (15 * k) 15) e

/-- `occasion_s6` (violated): A police officer directing traffic governs the subject's lane while the
    subject is alongside the vehicle (k = 13–15) only; the subject completes the pass (k = 16) where
    no officer governs. -/
def occasion_s6Trace : Trace :=
  basePass (fun _ => redFlashingFront) (fun k => 13 ≤ k && k ≤ 15)

/-- `occasion_s6_outside` (not_applicable): A police officer directing traffic governs the lane the
    subject occupies at every observation of the pass (from k = 13), and did not before it began;
    the officer waves the subject past. -/
def occasion_s6_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  basePass (fun _ => redFlashingFront) (fun k => 13 ≤ k)

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp)) (absent : List String := [])
    (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_267_2d"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := window
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) (some (11000, 19000)) ["sig.warning_lamp"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .notApplicable (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated (some (11000, 15000))
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .violated (some (11000, 15000))
  , witness "branch_6" branch_6Trace .compliant (some (13000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s1" occasion_s1Trace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s1_outside" occasion_s1_outsideTrace .notApplicable (some (16000, 24000))
  , witness "occasion_s3" occasion_s3Trace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occasion_s3_outsideTrace .notApplicable (some (13000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s7" occasion_s7Trace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s7_outside" occasion_s7_outsideTrace .notApplicable (some (13000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s6" occasion_s6Trace .violated (some (11000, 19000))
  , witness "occasion_s6_outside" occasion_s6_outsideTrace .notApplicable (some (13000, 19000)) ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_267_2d
